title: GSTR-9C

estimate.basis: GSTR-9C is filed with GSTR-9; its late fee is the one worked out for GSTR-9.

missing: GST_API_PUBLIC_KEY (GSTN’s public key, from your GSP)
gsp.label: GST system through your GSP

offlineSteps: GSTR-9C is filed after GSTR-9, with the audited financial statements.

On gst.gov.in open Returns Dashboard, pick the financial year, then GSTR-9C → Prepare Offline; prepare it in the GSTR-9C offline tool from the reconciliation on this screen and upload the JSON the tool makes.
File with DSC or EVC and mark it as filed here with the date and the ARN.
